findings.conflictNote: The document records an actual ISO 22716 certificate (Certificate No. IN-COS-22716-1988, issued 2024-05-20, valid until 2027-05-19), but this certificate is held by 'Sahyadri Beauty Group, Hosur Unit II' — a different site within the group. The same section explicitly states 'A site-specific ISO 22716 certificate for the Coimbatore unit has not been issued,' meaning the Coimbatore facility profiled in this document is not itself covered by a site-specific certificate, even though it operates under the same group quality management system.
findings.citationQuote: ISO 22716:2007 (Cosmetics GMP) — Certificate No. IN-COS-22716-1988, issued 2024-05-20, valid until 2027-05-19. Certificate holder: Sahyadri Beauty Group, Hosur Unit II.
